canonical_project: Apatura Plean AI Data Centre Campus

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Apatura submitted a Proposal of Application Notice to Stirling and Falkirk councils for a 43.1 ha Plean/Torwood AI data centre campus with 300MW utility capacity. DCD later reported Apatura changed location to Larbert, three miles from Plean; coded rejected to indicate the Stirling/Plean site did not proceed as the active site.
